answer: Decentralized AI agent networks mitigate Sybil attacks through physical-resource-backed proof of stake. Agents establish verifiable identity by cryptographically linking their state to real-world oracle data, such as tracking a verified timber delivery at an isolated island jetty. An attacker seeking to flood the network with fake identities faces prohibitive capital expenditure, as each Sybil node requires committing unique, high-value real-world physical assets.
